item.title: J&K on high alert ahead of Article 370 anniversary 'Black Day' protests
item.summary: Security forces have increased vigilance across Jammu region ahead of planned protests. Political parties National Conference, PDP, and Congress will mark August 5 as 'Black Day'. These demonstrations will occur outside their respective party headquarters in Jammu. Protesters are demanding restoration of statehood and constitutional safeguards for the region. Enhanced security measures include intensified vehicle checks and surveillance at sensitive locations.
